summary: Hosted API: intermittent SSE streaming disconnects (client sees connection closed)
description:
Issue summary:
Acme Analytics reports intermittent disconnects during streaming responses on the Hosted API. Their client receives "connection closed" / EOF while the model is still generating. Retries usually succeed.

Impact:
Customer chat feature drops partial completions; end-users see truncated responses ~1-3% of requests.

Environment:
Hosted API (OpenAI-compatible), streaming=true, us-east.

Steps to reproduce (customer):
1) Start a chat completion with streaming enabled (SSE).
2) After ~10-40 seconds, stream terminates unexpectedly.

Logs / notes:
Customer shared: "unexpected EOF reading response body" and occasional "http2: stream closed".
Support observed brief 499/connection resets at the edge around the reported times.
comments: Naomi Feldman (Support) 2026-03-08: Escalating to Eng; seeing multiple similar reports this week. Slack thread: #support https://slack/redwood/archives/support/p1772951300
Ethan Park (Platform) 2026-03-09: We might be hitting idle timeout / proxy buffering edge case on long streams. Pulling envoy/nginx timeouts for streaming routes.
Aisha Rahman (SRE) 2026-03-09: Noticed a small spike in upstream "downstream_cx_destroy" in us-east around 03/08 22:00-23:00 UTC. Correlates with edge deploy rwd-edge-1.42.0.
Ethan Park 2026-03-10: Reproduced in staging with forced long generations; the edge was closing connections when response headers were delayed after a brief backpressure window.
Naomi Feldman 2026-03-11: Customer asks for workaround; they can increase client retry but want root cause.
Ethan Park 2026-03-12: Mitigation shipped: increased streaming route timeouts and disabled response buffering for SSE on rwd-edge-1.42.1 in us-east. Monitoring 24h.
resolution: Resolved in prod us-east via edge config update rwd-edge-1.42.1 (SSE routes: increased idle timeout, disabled buffering). Workaround before fix: client-side retry on stream termination. Follow-up: roll config globally after validation; add alert for abnormal SSE disconnect ratio.
